description: Deploy a static site to Cloudflare Pages from CI (Direct Upload with wrangler), then check the live page is exactly the built one. Works with any stack: plain HTML/CSS/JS without a build, or any build command that writes a directory.

SITE_URL.description: Production URL without a trailing slash, e.g. https://okangal.com

CF_PROJECT.description: Cloudflare Pages project name, e.g. portfolio

BUILD_COMMAND.description: Command that builds the site, e.g. `pnpm run build`; empty when the files are deployed as they are

DIST_DIR.description: Directory that is deployed: the build output, or the folder holding the pages when there is no build (never the repository root)
